cat > /app/submit/README.md << 'EOF'
# IPv6 pipeline compiler / lookup engine

`./run` reads one JSON request per line on stdin and writes exactly one JSON
response per line on stdout.  No command line arguments are used; diagnostics
(only native build failures) go to stderr.

## Files

| file | role |
|---|---|
| `run` | launcher: builds the native helper on first use, then serves requests |
| `scamp_pipeline.py` | request parsing/validation, canonical IPv6 codec, node layout, exact optimiser, lookup |
| `scamp_accel.py` | ctypes wrapper for the native helper (with graceful degradation) |
| `helper.c` | optional native accelerator: JSON pre-scan, cut placement DP, batch LPM |

## Design notes

* **Parsing.** A cheap C pre-scan counts JSON values and nesting depth so a
  hostile 32 MiB line is rejected before `json.loads` can materialise it.
  The strict parser rejects duplicate keys, any floating point spelling and
  `NaN`/`Infinity`; every value is type checked (`bool` is never an `int`).
* **IPv6 text.** Parsing accepts only colon separated hexadecimal (compressed or
  expanded, case insensitive).  Serialisation implements the required canonical
  pure hexadecimal form directly (longest run of >= 2 zero groups, leftmost on a
  tie), independent of any library.
* **Layout.** `build_layout` derives the fully determined node/rule/edge layout
  and per-stage bit usage from the FIB and the cuts.  It is used both to emit
  compile images and to re-derive (and therefore validate) lookup images.
* **Placement.** `U(b,e)` depends only on the interval, so minimising
  `max_i U(c[i],c[i+1])/capacities[i]` is a shortest-path style DP over
  (stage, depth).  All comparisons are exact integer cross products, so the
  result is an exact rational global optimum; peak > 1 means infeasible.
  The DP runs in the native helper; `py_find_cuts` is an equivalent pure python
  implementation used when no compiler is available, and every native result is
  cross checked against `build_layout` before it is emitted.
* **Lookup.** The image is re-derived and validated (structure, ordering,
  canonical spelling, costs, capacities, peak), after which answers are exact
  longest-prefix matches over its rules, computed natively when possible.
EOF
